notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLOS page gives the footings statement, the 2020 registration, the nominator and the administrator. The Forest Lookouts South Tower entry is only a name, county and forest. Two searches found no build date, design, height, staffing, fires or access information. A 1957 photo caption from a Historic Florida group (seen in a search snippet only; not fetched or cited) mentions a South Tower Recreation Area in the Ocala forest; worth checking in a state or Forest Service archive. The brief's access 'unknown' is left unfilled because no source states an access level.
